text: DSH Subscription Overlay 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的订阅额度浮层，在界面侧栏/停靠区显示 Claude、Codex、OpenCode Go 和 CommandCode 的账户用量。主机端读取已保存的订阅凭据并获取各服务的用量快照，浏览器端提供可切换的胶囊或圆环、四家服务的用量面板及设置页。用户可以查看不同周期的额度和重置时间、设置轮询间隔与告警阈值、启停提供方，并记录 CommandCode 的月度 token 消耗。适合需要在 DSH 会话中快速掌握多个模型订阅余量的用户；安装要求 DSH 网页端，凭据沿用 DSH 凭据或会话配置。

DSH Subscription Overlay shows Claude, Codex, OpenCode Go, and CommandCode usage in the DSH web client. Its dock badge or floating pill opens a panel with quota windows and reset times. Users can adjust polling and alerts, toggle providers, and track CommandCode monthly token burn.

DSH Subscription Overlay 的功能「多服务额度总览」：在面板中并列展示 Claude、Codex、OpenCode Go 和 CommandCode 的订阅用量状态与周期数据。打开网页端浮层或停靠区徽标即可查看。
DSH Subscription Overlay 的功能「可切换的用量浮层」：用户可用快捷键或设置切换显示，也能选择胶囊或圆环样式，并在圆环模式下轮换展示提供方。点击浮层打开详细额度面板。
DSH Subscription Overlay 的功能「额度和告警设置」：设置页可以启停各提供方、修改轮询分钟数、用量告警阈值及 CommandCode 月预算。通过设置页开关或快捷键隐藏后，界面组件会卸载。
DSH Subscription Overlay 的功能「订阅用量刷新」：主机并行读取提供方的当前用量并保留已知的成功快照，界面可按配置轮询，用户也能点击刷新按钮立即更新。
DSH Subscription Overlay 的功能「CommandCode 月度消耗记录」：主机把 token 样本追加到本地 burn ledger，并在面板显示本月累计量；设置预算后可同时显示预算占比。
DSH Subscription Overlay 会把 CommandCode 的 token 消耗样本保存在本机 DSH 数据目录的 burn.json；面板累计值来自该本地账本。

@dsh-external/dsh-subscription-overlay README · dsh-subscription-overlay：Toggleable DSH web-overlay that aggregates subscription quota for **Claude**,
**Codex**, and **opencode-go** (fresh OAuth/session fetches), plus a
**commandcode** availability probe and a local monthly burn ledger.

> Honesty rule: commandcode has no quota endpoint, so the card shows
> probe state (online/offline + latency) and local burn only —
> **never a fabricated percentage**. When no monthly budget is set,
> no percentage bar is rendered at all.

@dsh-external/dsh-subscription-overlay README · What it does：- **Overlay floater** (`shell.overlay` slot, own plugin id — composites with
  the stock `dsh-quota` pill): draggable pill **or** ring mode, alert badge,
  click opens the 4-provider panel, staleness-triggered refresh.
- **4-provider panel**: per-window usage bars + reset times for
  claude (5h/7d), codex (primary/secondary), opencode-go (5h/7d/monthly);
  commandcode shows probe + burn only.
- **Toggle**: `Ctrl+Shift+S` hotkey, settings-section switch, and host master
  switch. Hidden unmounts pill/ring **and** panel and stops polling.
- **Settings section** (order 56, next to Task Router): master toggle, four
  provider toggles, poll interval (1–60 min), alert threshold (1–100%),
  commandcode monthly budget in tokens (`0` = track only, no %).
- **Same-origin HTTP API** (all POSTs require the `x-dsh-subscription-overlay`
  CSRF header):
  - `GET  /plugins/dsh-subscription-overlay/api/status` → `{ refreshedAt, providers[4], alertPct, overlay, enabled, settings }`
  - `POST /plugins/dsh-subscription-overlay/api/refresh` → force re-fetch
  - `POST /plugins/dsh-subscription-overlay/api/probe` → commandcode re-probe
